schemas: WITH bounded AS (SELECT nspname, pg_get_userbyid(nspowner) AS owner, nspacl FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname='public' LIMIT 4097), packed AS (SELECT count(*) AS row_count,coalesce(json_agg(bounded),'[]'::json)::text AS payload FROM bounded) SELECT row_count,octet_length(payload) AS payload_bytes,CASE WHEN row_count<=4096 AND octet_length(payload)<=2097152 THEN payload ELSE NULL END AS payload FROM packed

WITH bounded AS (SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relkind, c.relpersistence, c.relispartition, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity, c.relreplident, c.reloptions, c.relacl, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner, a.amname AS access_method, t.spcname AS tablespace,
 CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,false) END AS view_definition,
 CASE WHEN c.relispartition THEN pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound,c.oid,false) END AS partition_bound,
 CASE WHEN c.relkind='p' THEN pg_get_partkeydef(c.oid) END AS partition_key
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am a ON a.oid=c.relam LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_tablespace t ON t.oid=c.reltablespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY c.relname COLLATE "C" LIMIT 4097), packed AS (SELECT count(*) AS row_count,coalesce(json_agg(bounded),'[]'::json)::text AS payload FROM bounded) SELECT row_count,octet_length(payload) AS payload_bytes,CASE WHEN row_count<=4096 AND octet_length(payload)<=2097152 THEN payload ELSE NULL END AS payload FROM packed
